title: Circuit Breaker
subtitle: Stop calling a failing dependency, so its slowness does not eat every thread you have
motto: Fail fast beats waiting to fail
keyInsight: One slow dependency can use every worker thread and fail requests that never touch it; a breaker fails those calls in a millisecond instead, and its open time decides how fast you recover.

decisions.title: Fail requests that never touch the dependency
decisions.description: The first frame counts failures across all requests, including the half that do not call the dependency, because a saturated thread pool takes those down too.
decisions.alternatives: Counting only dependency calls would understate the damage a slow dependency does.

decisions.title: Charge the breaker for staying open too long
decisions.description: The failure frame counts seconds the breaker rejects calls after the dependency has recovered, since the open time is the one setting it can get wrong.
decisions.alternatives: Showing the breaker only working would hide that it can hurt a healthy service.
